explanation: erdosproblems.com/615: Sudakov [Su03] proved rt(n; 4, n e^{−f(n)}) = o(n²) whenever f(n)/√(log n) → ∞. The Lean statement: under that hypothesis, for every ε > 0 and all large n, every K₄-free G on Fin n with α(G) ≤ n e^{−f(n)} has at most εn² edges. The boundary convention (α ≤ vs <) for the Ramsey–Turán number does not matter for an o(n²) statement. Faithful.
